meta.title: Token Usage
meta.description: Collects the usage reported by the model, totals tokens per day and per model, and adds a viewer entry at the bottom left of the web UI (above the settings button): a stacked bar chart shows each model's usage and share per day, and hovering a segment reveals the model, its color, the share and the amount. Two switches: 'normalize model names' (strip the provider prefix, unify casing) and 'merge badges' (on by default: drop trailing plan/build markers such as -TokenPlan / -Free / build numbers, so variants of one model collapse into a single row, e.g. DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731-TokenPlan and -0817-DL → DeepSeek-V4-Flash); both change display only and never touch the raw model ids in the ledger. The ledger lives under the app data root (%LOCALAPPDATA%\DeepSeekHarness\data\usage.json), not in the plugin directory. It also re-draws the readings below the composer as '1 轮 80 步 · 速度 142 t/s' / '消耗 570 万 · 缓存命中 88%' / '上下文 55%（144K/262K）' (it shadows the two core pills by id and paints its own click-open panels).
